title: 第202章 猜测还魂第201章 上头调查
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: “有意思，天牢之中居然还有这么一号猛人。”
夏安抚摸着那片凹陷的墙体，微微合上双眼。
“狂暴的真气，打斗过程虽然激烈，但怎么一下子就结束了……”
夏安在心中低语，就算如今已经过去了一段时间，那墙壁还残留着猛烈的真气。
这气息从天牢深处一路向外扩张，而气息最浓厚的地方，正是他所在之处。
证明那神秘出手者在此地至少与人缠斗了一段时间。
“奇怪，那最后为何没有打起来？”
片刻后，夏安缩回了手，陷入了沉思当中。
范卫昭与钟崖站在远处，注视着那斩妖队的夏大人，一会皱眉思考，一会走走停停。
他们不敢出声打扰，生怕将对方思绪打断。
直到夏安收回了手，他们才小心翼翼地问道：
“夏大人，这天牢入侵者到底怎么了？”
事到如今他们也算是看出来了，今晚的事情并非是镇魔司高层来此练功，多半还真是出现了意外。
夏安回过神来，随手一指向了间深处牢房。
“那间牢房关押着什么人？”
这牢房与其余的牢房大差不差，都已轰然倒塌成了一个废墟，看上去丝毫不起眼。
范卫昭愣了片刻，随后很快便反应过来，脸色有些苍白：
“那间牢房关押的是离魂老鬼沈寂玄。”
“沈寂玄？”
夏安脚步停顿，感觉这个名字有些耳熟，但一时间又想不到在哪里听说过。
“就是那个被四大宗联合镇压的魔头。”
直到钟崖低声提醒，夏安才回想起来沈寂玄的名号。
毕竟在几十年前沈寂玄一夜杀了近千数平民抽魂修炼，引得正道宗门联合围剿的事件极为出名。
夏安当时刚入斩妖队也听闻过这些传闻，不过他早以为对方已经死亡了。
倒是没有想到沈寂玄居然被关押到了天牢之中。
念及此处，夏安眸光闪动，单手从腰间拔出长剑。
众人还未看清发生了什么，就见到数不清的剑气动荡，数千道白光劈过。
哗啦哗啦。
堵塞牢门的石块就瞬间化为了齑粉，露出里面的真容。
夏安身影一闪消失在原地，过了几息。
夏安脸色阴沉，带来了个坏消息：
“沈寂玄死了。”
“死了？”
众人先是一愣，随后便是不敢置信：
“沈寂玄怎么可能死了？”
这位曾经的先天境巅峰的囚犯，就算被关在牢中数十载，但那一身实力可没有半分消退。
要知道当初更是连宗师境高手前来，也无法将沈寂玄给抹杀，最后只能先将其关在天牢之中。
钟崖想到之前的传闻，补充道：
“也不一定是死了，我听说此人专练神魂一道，还会借尸还魂的招数，当初便是因为此原因，才一直没有动手。”
夏安视线扭了过去，看向那群已经坍塌碎裂的囚笼：
“你的意思是说这沈寂玄借尸还魂后，将这天牢扰乱，想要趁机逃出去？”
“属下也只是猜测。”
“先封锁天牢，等镇魔司派人吧。”夏安揉了揉眉心。
他并非是镇狱司的顶头上司，也无权继续探索下去。
他刚从京城内回来没过一周就遭遇此事，这京城看来真如传言当中混乱起来。
content_en:
"It's interesting that there is such a fierce person in the prison."
Xia An stroked the sunken wall and closed his eyes slightly.
"The violent infuriating energy, although the fighting process was fierce, why did it end all at once..."
Xia An whispered in his heart, even though some time has passed, the wall still retains strong energy.
This aura expanded all the way from the depths of the Tianlao, and the place with the strongest aura was exactly where he was.
It proves that the mysterious shooter has been fighting with people here for at least a while.
"Strange, then why didn't they fight in the end?"
After a moment, Xia An retracted his hand and fell into deep thought.
Fan Weizhao and Zhong Ya stood in the distance, watching Master Xia of the demon-slaying team, sometimes frowning and thinking, sometimes walking around.
They didn't dare to disturb each other for fear of interrupting each other's thoughts.
It wasn't until Xia An took back his hand that they asked cautiously:
"Master Xia, what happened to the intruder in the prison?"
By now they have finally figured out that what happened tonight was not that the senior officials of the Demon Suppressing Division came here to practice, but that there was probably an accident.
Xia An came back to his senses and pointed to a deep cell.
"Who is in that cell?"
This cell was much the same as the other cells. They had all collapsed into ruins and looked unremarkable at all.
Fan Weizhao was stunned for a moment, and then he quickly came to his senses, his face a little pale:
"That cell holds the old ghost Shen Jixuan."
"Shen Jixuan?"
Xia An paused, feeling that the name sounded familiar, but for a moment he couldn't think of where he had heard it.
"It's the devil who was suppressed by the four major sects."
It wasn't until Zhong Ya reminded him in a low voice that Xia An recalled Shen Jixuan's name.
After all, decades ago, Shen Jixuan killed nearly a thousand civilians in one night to extract their souls and practice, which led to a joint siege by the Zhengdao sects. The incident was extremely famous.
Xia An had just joined the demon-slaying team and heard these rumors, but he had long thought that the opponent was dead.
He didn't expect that Shen Jixuan would be imprisoned in the sky prison.
Thinking of this, Xia An's eyes flashed and he pulled out the long sword from his waist with one hand.
Before everyone could see what was happening, they saw countless sword energy turbulence and thousands of white lights passing through.
Clatter. Clatter.
The stone blocking the cell door instantly turned into powder, revealing the true appearance inside.
Xia An's figure disappeared in a flash, and a few breaths passed.
Xia An looked gloomy and brought bad news:
"Shen Jixuan is dead."
"Dead?"
Everyone was stunned at first, and then they couldn't believe it:
"How could Shen Jixuan be dead?"
Even though this prisoner who was once at the peak of the Xiantian Realm has been locked up in prison for decades, his strength has not faded at all.
You must know that even the masters at the master level were unable to kill Shen Jixuan, and in the end they could only lock him in the sky prison.
Zhong Ya thought of the previous rumors and added:
"It's not necessarily that he's dead. I heard that this person specializes in the art of spiritual souls and can also use the technique of reviving corpses. It was for this reason that he never took action."
Xia An turned his gaze and looked at the collapsed and broken cages:
"You mean that Shen Jixuan, after resurrecting his body, disrupted the prison and wanted to take the opportunity to escape?"
"My subordinates are just guessing."
"Seal the prison first and wait for the Demon Suppression Division to send someone." Xia An rubbed his brows.
He is not the immediate superior of the Prison Department, and he has no right to continue exploring.
He encountered this incident just a week after returning from the capital. The capital seemed to be in chaos as rumored.
